test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 30 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'PUNCH' is written as 'OWMEG' and 'SHAWL' is written as 'RJZYK'. How will 'KARMA' be written in that language?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7ca63fa0a9b1d8d94e9032be998e74b7faff301d8847e785439c04e89b02dfd4.png] 

 For 'PUNCH' is coded as 'OWMEG' 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/224d0792dd5896aa136bb2f8902cdd27972c542a3b70c752587be5bda966d22a.png] 

For 'SHAWL' is coded as 'RJZYK'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1f83dd16a97b2a2cd3a455eed377395a748240c33bd4098c5db47fef06c09935.png] 

Similarly** 'KARMA' will be coded as 'JCQOZ'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0ddf05327ea77eb128894ceb3ad4902dcff8a876118b81732b20eb119f4ebb59.png] 

Hence the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
